pairs.rule: A figure presents its data as a continuous plotted curve; a rendered table of labels and numeric values is not a plot.
pairs.defect: the data is set as a table of text rows, not plotted as a curve

pairs.rule: Text set on a dark or saturated ground holds strong contrast against it, such as near-white on a saturated or dark fill.
pairs.defect: a mid-grey label is set on a saturated blue fill, giving weak contrast

pairs.rule: Body text, the axis tick labels and direct labels, is set at or above the legibility floor of 20 pt.
pairs.defect: the tick labels and direct label are set at 8 pt, well below the 20 pt floor

pairs.rule: The figure carries only its data and the minimum needed to read it: flat marks, hairline rules and direct labels, with no gradient, shadow, decorative fill or gridline.
pairs.defect: the bars carry a vertical gradient and a drop shadow, the plot has a decorative background fill and gridlines are drawn

pairs.rule: A poloidal-flux plot labels its colour axis with the quantity and its unit, poloidal flux [Wb].
pairs.defect: the colour axis carries no label, so the plotted quantity and unit are unstated
